prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 75.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 78.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Custom Pet Preview Studio Screen: Adds a new pet preview studio screen right after photo uploads to allow users to inspect and customize pet rendering before finalizing adoption. (why: Support receives multiple tickets about custom pet rendering failures, and adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9%.)
1: [sign_in, new_screen] Account Cloud Sync & Pet Recovery Screen: Inserts a dedicated cloud sync screen after sign-in that automatically scans and confirms existing pet save data restoration. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, redesign] Split Diagnostic Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split layout with asset progress on the left and a live desktop rendering diagnostic checklist on the right. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s, and users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop.)
3: [adoption, hint] Cloud Save Guarantee Hint on Adoption Certificate: Adds a cloud persistence hint on the adoption certificate screen reassuring users that pet ownership is permanently linked to their account. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets following account login.)
4: [adoption, layout] Split Trait Comparison Layout for Pet Selection: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a two-column split view displaying detailed personality traits alongside live previews. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion) and long completion times.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Engine Initialization Diagnostic: Displays real-time diagnostic status updates on the waiting screen to notify users of screen coordinate verification. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show up on the desktop or the app fails to open.)
6: [finish, notification] System Tray Quick-Control Desktop Notification: Enables a ready notification banner explaining how to interact with the pet via the system tray icon upon reaching home_intro. (why: Users expressed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery Reassurance Copy on Sign-In: Updates sign-in title and body copy to emphasize automatic account recovery and instant pet restoration. (why: Address user hesitation and confusion around account resets and missing pet data.)
